summary.intent: Orchestrate multiple background subagent workers in the caliper project to fix and land several issues/PRs (#347/#343 staleness and findings, #353 conflict resolution, #367/#348/#349).
summary.outcome: No work was completed in this segment; the transcript only shows repeated interim notices from the #347 worker, which is still waiting on slow CI, while the #353 and #367/#348/#349 workers remain running.

repo: Caliper agent workers run in isolated git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/agent-<id>, each on a branch named worktree-agent-<id>.
CI for #347 is slow enough that the worker spends long periods waiting on it.
workflow: A subagent task-notification with status 'completed' can be only an interim notice: when the agent is waiting on its own background work, it will report later via SubagentHandback, so the result should not be treated as final.
Repeated interim notifications from a waiting worker carry no new information and need no action beyond tracking which workers are still outstanding.

friction: The #347 worker emitted several repeated interim 'waiting on background work' notifications (237 tool uses, ~52 minutes elapsed) with no progress, adding noise.
Slow CI is blocking completion of #347.
open_items: Await final report from the #347/#343 worker once CI finishes.
